title: phaseolus vulgaris var. jodomelas
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. jodomelas, commonly known as the yellow bean or yellow kidney bean, is a variety of the common bean. It is a nutrient-rich plant that provides health benefits such as reducing the risk of heart disease, managing blood sugar levels, and aiding in weight management due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Phaseolus vulgaris var. jodomelas include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
